issues.title: TX/LO/acquisition phase-reference closure remains unmeasured
issues.basis: Legacy audits raise coherence concerns; v2 proposes capture inputs labeled ECO-1.

issues.title: Shared-coil transmit/receive isolation remains an instrument blocker
issues.basis: Historical electronics report describes separate TX/RX nets, clamp loading for a shared connection, and no isolating T/R switch.
issues.next_action: Check live board/source revision; validate a chosen topology and RX recovery. A calculated diode-drop parameter is not proof of applied hardware.

issues.title: B0 current/field stability has not been experimentally closed
issues.basis: Historical report describes voltage-driven operation and absent B0 current sensing at its audited revision.
issues.next_action: Verify revised current-drive/sensing design, compliance and drift/noise evidence; do not substitute simulation for measurements.

issues.title: Fault wiring, LNA feedback and power protection need source-specific closure
issues.basis: Later audit reports unwired PA flags, J3-dependent feedback and power-sequencing/protection concerns.
issues.next_action: Check actual connectivity and hardware revision; validate safe states before connecting/energizing the real chain. Do not inherit an automatic-abort claim.

issues.basis: One parity run precedes the 125 kS/s/decimation 5 and pin-map changes.
